redrawn from the exact 1-2 formula; one curve per R
1 shell pass, 2 or more tube passes
R = (T₁ − T₂)/(t₂ − t₁) on the curves
Mark P = 0.467 on the horizontal axis.
Go straight up to the curve for R = 1.143 (between the printed 1.0 and 1.5 curves; interpolate).
Go across to the F axis.
